response.justification: The candidate is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. Professional C++ work is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015; the last decade is almost entirely JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang web/backend work. There is no evidence of Windows-platform C++ development, no SQL Server or Oracle experience (only generic SQL/MySQL/MongoDB), and no fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking domain exposure beyond a fintech role at RIDE Capital focused on Node/GraphQL. Strong fundamentals, testing discipline, and communication skills are evident, but they do not offset the gap in the three mandatory areas.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience with strong TDD/CI-CD and craftsmanship practices
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, DLang)
Excellent communication demonstrated through talks, workshops, and course authoring
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago, and not on Windows
No SQL Server/Oracle depth; database experience is mostly MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking domain exposure

key_factors.factor: General senior engineering and systems depth
